title: Gift-Card Balance Fragmentation
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftcard:balance
| stats count as cards, sum(balance) as total_balance, avg(balance) as avg_balance by merchant
| sort - total_balance
description: Shows where value is trapped in lots of half-used gift cards and vouchers.
value: Fragmented balances are easy to forget and often expire before they ever become useful.
implementation: Ingest gift-card balances in `index=personal`; summarize card count and value per merchant.
visualization: Merchant table of cards held, total balance, and average remaining balance.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how much value is scattered across partly used gift cards instead of being spent while it still matters.
